title: Senior Software Engineer

Required Skills and Experience • Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. • Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills. • Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. • Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services. • Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues. • Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! title: Software Engineer
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter. About the role We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix. Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself. Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers. Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them. Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next. Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes. You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments. We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. Technical background You've built production software with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it. Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents. Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it. Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability. One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why. Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked. Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable. Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it. Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them. Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work. Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to. Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

description: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. Job Description Experian Partner Solutions (EPS) is looking for Senior Web Engineers to build the products our partners white label as their own – embedded components that run inside partner applications, and turnkey hosted sites that carry a partner's brand. When a partner puts our software in front of their customers, our code runs under their brand, in their environment, with their reputation attached. There is no margin for "it works on my machine." We are looking for problem solvers first. We care much more about the depth and judgment you bring than about which specific frameworks you have used. Our stack is predominantly JavaScript and TypeScript across the browser and the server – React on the front end, Node in our services and tooling. We are building this team around AI-assisted development. That is not a perk in the job description – it is the operating model. You will spend a significant share of your time directing AI coding agents, reviewing what those agents produce, and being personally accountable for code you did not type character by character. If that sounds like a downgrade of the craft, this is the wrong role. If it sounds like the most leveraged version of the job you have ever had, keep reading. This is a senior individual contributor role. We are looking for someone with the architecture judgment to decide what to build, not just the speed to build it. Own web software end-to-end – design, build, ship, and support it in production. Ownership does not stop at the merge. Direct AI coding agents as your primary implementation method rather than hand-writing every line. Decompose features into work an agent can execute reliably, and write the prompts and specs that make that possible. Make the architecture calls AI cannot make for you: interface and API design, state and service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility for consumers who depend on your releases. Design for environments you do not control, whether that is a hostile host page, an unfamiliar partner configuration, or an unexpected client of your API. Use AI to generate test suites and regression coverage, then hunt what the generator missed: adversarial inputs, integration conflicts, and configuration edge cases. Assess blast radius before you merge — in a multi-tenant product, a change that is wrong for one partner is often wrong for all of them. Agentic Responsibilities: Fluent use of AI coding assistants – Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, or equivalent – as a primary development tool. Ability to decompose a non-trivial feature into chunks an agent completes reliably. A track record of catching real bugs, security issues, and bad architectural choices in AI-generated code. Ability to explain what makes a prompt produce usable code rather than plausible-looking garbage. Use of AI to generate tests, paired with a clear view of where those tests give false confidence. Architecture and system-design judgment that weighs at least as heavily as tooling fluency. Calibrated skepticism – you can name specific things AI is bad at in your domain. Qualifications 6+ years building and shipping production web software, with real ownership of what you built after it went live. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience. Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, applied across the browser and the server. We work primarily in React and Node; deep expertise in a comparable ecosystem plus evidence you pick up new stacks quickly is equally welcome. Component libraries, design systems, or SDKs consumed by teams outside your own — where breaking changes carry real cost. Server-side or full-stack web work — Node services, APIs, and the integrations that connect a customer-facing product to the systems behind it. Practical web security awareness: injection and XSS vectors, authentication and session handling, dependency risk, and safe handling of sensitive data. Experience with DevOps and CI/CD, automated test and build tooling. Additional Information Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers. Direct AI coding agents as your primary implementation method rather than hand-writing every line. Decompose features into work an agent can execute reliably, and write the prompts and specs that make that possible. Make the architecture calls AI cannot make for you: interface and API design, state and service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility for consumers who depend on your releases. Design for environments you do not control, whether that is a hostile host page, an unfamiliar partner configuration, or an unexpected client of your API. Use AI to generate test suites and regression coverage, then hunt what the generator missed: adversarial inputs, integration conflicts, and configuration edge cases. Assess blast radius before you merge — in a multi-tenant product, a change that is wrong for one partner is often wrong for all of them.
